why_it_breaks: The agent added valuation_target and time_stop to the discretionary_exits list while relying on the notes to exempt them from the swing-trade cap. However, the cap enforcement in caps.py checks every exit order against swings_this_quarter >= caps.swing_trades_per_quarter regardless of whether the exit is in discretionary_exits or blocked. The notes claim "Discretionary sells do not" [refer to the cap], but the code does not implement that exemption - it blocks any exit once the cap is reached, including discretionary ones. The three positions were sold without the cap check preventing them, causing the quarter count to go from 1 to 4, exceeding the cap of 2.
